exposure: Women diagnosed with HIV before the pandemic
Women diagnosed with HIV after the pandemic
finding: The COVID-19 pandemic was associated with a reduction in HIV detection rate during pregnancy, lower antiretroviral use during childbirth, and fewer vaginal and cesarean births among women diagnosed with HIV.
mod_finding: A 55% reduction in vaginal births and 39% in cesarean sections were observed among women diagnosed with HIV after the start of the pandemic.
